items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: when she married Lenny Hayton [phonetic] I started paying attention, because not only, you know, he taught her everything.

ctx.x: Oh, she‘s just fabulous. Well, see, when she married Lenny Hayton [phonetic] I started paying attention, because not only, you know, he taught her everything. He also picked all those great songs that she was singing. He did all those arrangements and stuff. So she doesn‘t have a great voice, but she can put on that song. That song she does in The Wiz?
